cases.name: Riki Amix
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Riki had many passions in life but her favorite things were cows, coffee, coke zero, cigarettes, and family.  She loved her farm and doing farm work. It didn’t matter if she was feeding cows or fixing fence, she loved the work.  Most of all, Riki loved her family, especially her husband Dakota, and her children.  She will be missed by all who knew and loved her."
